name: Teito Kitan ~Doushi Tantei no Jiken Memo~
original_name: 帝都奇譚 〜道士探偵の事件メモ〜
source:
Taisho era. A series of kidnappings of young girls have happened in the capital with the aim of selling into sexual slavery. A special detective trained in fighting is sent to investigate the case.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大正时代。首都发生了一连串年轻女孩绑架案，目的在于将她们卖作性奴隶。一名受过战斗训练的特殊侦探奉命调查此案。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
